rationale: Free public company register front-end; standalone lookup surface for HU bank/PSP entity identity and new incorporations.
Authoritative certified company data but paid/registration-gated; a human must clear commercial access first.
Official Company Gazette: earliest public signal of formations, mergers, insolvency and account deposits in the HU banking/payments chain.
BÉT issuer directory is an enumerable, continuously updated seed list of listed HU financial issuers and their disclosure pages.
MNB supervised-institution register is the definitive actor map for HU banks, payment institutions and e-money issuers.
Index page over MNB register infrastructure; covered by monitoring the institution search and mnb.hu parent.
Searchable licensing and enforcement decisions — new PSP entrants and incumbent failures surface here first.
Aranykönyv per-institution supervisory financials, recurring annual dataset covering banks, PSPs and e-money issuers.
Guidance hub on issuer supervision; interpretive context rather than a standalone signal producer on mnb.hu.
Pillar 3 guidance section of mnb.hu; valuable as a locator for bank-level disclosure pages but a sub-page of the parent.
National legislation database is a durable legal-reference source; url_verification failed so re-check liveness before approving.
Magyar Közlöny is the first venue for acts and MNB decrees on interchange, transaction levy and cash provision.
ESMA OAM/ESAP index — durable supranational access layer that will centralise HU regulated information.
Static country description of the HU business register; useful reference documentation, not a recurring signal source.
Commercial reseller of derived filing data with low credibility and unclear licensing; redundant to e-beszámoló and MNB.
English mirror of the Golden Books datasets; materially lowers normalisation cost for multi-country modelling.
Top-level index of MNB supervisory statistics; canonical crawl entry point for discovering new or renamed datasets.
Sitemap of the same statistical portal; a crawl aid folded into monitoring of the statistics hub.
Quarterly per-institution credit-institution tables — the highest-frequency quantitative base for HU bank tracking.
Historical archive of the credit-institution tables; needed for long time series and exited/merged institutions.
Non-bank financial enterprise statistics (leasing, factoring, consumer lending) — adjacent actors within the both-sector scope.
Passporting register showing HU bank/PSP cross-border notifications — leading indicator of regional expansion.
Resolution-authority decisions; rare but very high-signal events reshaping the competitive map.
Continuously updated index of MNB recommendations defining what institutions must disclose and when.
Single static PDF guidance note; keep as evidence for interpreting Pillar 3 obligations, not as a monitored feed.
Reporting-framework documentation for credit institutions; decodes template semantics and definitional breaks in published series.
Payment-institution reporting templates define the ceiling of collectable HU payments metrics — core to the payments half of scope.
MNB payment statistics releases: transactions, fraud, PSP infrastructure, VIBER/BKR/KELER — definitive HU payments dataset.
